attempts.raw: {"risk": 4, "reason": "The new \"useCdn\" case is bugged\u2014it assigns to the \"name\" variable instead of a useCdn field, meaning any liquid template using {% script useCdn: ... %} will silently overwrite the script's name (likely breaking script resolution) rather than actually setting CDN usage."}

reason: The new "useCdn" case is bugged—it assigns to the "name" variable instead of a useCdn field, meaning any liquid template using {% script useCdn: ... %} will silently overwrite the script's name (likely breaking script resolution) rather than actually setting CDN usage.
